description.html: This 60x35x45 cm aquarium (94.5 L) strikes a good balance between size and practicality: roomy enough for a variety of fish, yet compact enough not to dominate the room. The quality of the glass and joints guarantees durability.

A volume of nearly 100 liters opens up the possibility of a biotope approach: recreating the natural habitat of the Amazon River, African lakes or Southeast Asia. We recommend an external filter, a CO2 system for plants and quality LED lighting.

We build custom aquariums: any dimensions, glass thickness matched to the volume, optional openings for filters and heaters. Call us or message us on WhatsApp for a consultation and a price. Delivery to all cities in Serbia.
